landing_capability_soil_desc: Hlola ulwazi olutholakalayo ngenhlabathi; ukuhlolwa kwasendaweni kanye nokuhunyushwa kochwepheshe kuseyinto ebalulekile.
landing_capability_advisory_desc: Hlola izimbangela ezingaba khona kanye nolwazi olutholiwe; ukuqinisekiswa kochwepheshe kuyadingeka.

landing_sim_nutrient_recovery_sms: Isibonelo: Buza uchwepheshe womhlabathi mayelana nesimo sensimu emva kwemvula.
landing_sim_nutrient_recovery_whatsapp: Isibonelo: Yabelana ngemiphumela yokuhlolwa komhlabathi nochwepheshe wendawo.

landing_how_step_1_desc: Khomba ikhamera yakho kunoma yiliphi iqabunga eliphuzi, isithelo esinamabala, ukubola kwesiqu, noma izinambuzane epulazini lakho.
landing_how_step_2_desc: Ukuhlola kuphakamisa izimbangela ezingaba khona; akukona ukuxilongwa okuqinisekisiwe.
landing_how_step_3_desc: Qinisekisa imbangela nezinketho ezigunyazwe endaweni nesikhulu sezolimo ngaphambi kokwelapha.
landing_faq_1_question: Ingabe lolu hlelo lokusebenza lusebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka kwe-inthanethi okusebenzayo emasimini asemakhaya?
landing_faq_1_answer: Ezinye izinqubo zasensimini zisekela ukusetshenziswa ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi nokuvumelanisa lapho ukuxhumana kubuya. Ukuhlaziywa kwamafu nedatha yangaphandle yamanje kudinga ukuxhumana; ukutholakala kuncike kudivayisi nasekufakweni kwayo.
landing_faq_2_question: Ingabe ngidinga i-smartphone ebiza kakhulu ukuze ngisebenzise i-GPExts?
landing_faq_2_answer: Uhlelo lokusebenza lwewebhu lusekela iziphequluli zamaselula. Ukutholakala kwe-SMS ne-USSD kuncike ekucushweni komhlinzeki nenethiwekhi; thintana nenhlangano yakho ukuze wazi iziteshi ezisekelwayo.
landing_faq_3_question: Ingabe i-GPExts imahhala kubalimi abancane abazimele?
landing_faq_3_answer: Ukutholakala nentengo kuncike enhlanganweni yakho kanye nokusetshenziswa kwayo. Hlola imininingwane yohlelo lwamanje ngaphambi kokubhalisa.
landing_faq_4_question: Yiziphi izitshalo nezifo zezitshalo ezisekelwayo njengamanje?
landing_faq_4_answer: Isalathiso sezifo sihlanganisa izitshalo nezimo eziningi, kodwa ukutholakala nokunemba kuyahluka. Imiphumela iyiziphakamiso, hhayi ukuxilongwa okuqinisekisiwe; thintana nochwepheshe bendawo.
landing_faq_5_question: Ngingakwazi ukulalela izeluleko ngolimi lwami lwendabuko?
landing_faq_5_answer: Ukusekelwa kolimi nenkulumo kuyahluka ngokwesici, isiphequluli, kanye nomhlinzeki ocushiwe. Hlola izinketho zolimi nomsindo ezitholakalayo ekusetshenzisweni kwakho.
landing_faq_6_question: Izikhulu Zokunwetshwa Kwezolimo (Agricultural Extension Officers) kanye NemiNyango bayisebenzisa kanjani i-GPExts?
landing_faq_6_answer: Izikhulu zokweluleka zisebenzisa i-GPExts ezithuthuthwini nasekuvakasheleni amasimu ukuze zibhalise abalimi, zibalaze imingcele yamasimu, zirekhode umlando wokubhekwa, futhi zixhumanise ukuvikelwa kokugqashuka kwezifo. Iminyango nezinhlangano ezibambisanayo zisebenzisa i-web portal ukubuka amamephu okushisa okugqashuka kwezifo esifundeni namarekhodi amasimu.
